Review Title: A Mystery $37 extra... and a Wannabe ai Bot.
Review Text:
I had some negative experiences in the past with UberEATS but my friend really wanted to order lunch and I figured maybe UberEATS has cleaned up their game a bit... so we placed an order.

No, they have not. We ordered 2 sandwiches that were $11.40 each and no breakdown was given - only a final total of $59.00. Then there was no receipt. We cancelled because we had no idea what that extra $37 was for... and it gave the 'cancel' option so we did cancel. We got on their chat-bot thing and it didn't offer any cost breakdown. No explanation. It just said we cancelled so the cancellation charge would be $41 because the restaurant started making our order.

We called Mendocino Farms immediately and they said they not only didn't start making our order, but they hadn't even received it at all. I am diligent about unscrupulous tactics of certain unknown companies but never expected to be scammed by such a big corporation.

The bot had its standard responses. We called my friend's bank and the $41 charge was already there. No lunch. No explanation of the excess $37 charge was. Did they add a tip on there for us? Did Calif. taxes suddenly grow to be 50% They won't say. What an unprofessional inconvenient experience. Now we have to file a Fraud report with her charge card. There are other delivery services out there, and I just want to put a serious warning out there for everyone to heed.
